entries.speaker: Disaster Shadows
entries.en: There are Shadows in the Metaverse called[n][clr 2]Disaster Shadows[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Disaster Shadows
entries.en: Disaster Shadows will not act. However, [clr 2]when[n]attacked, they will counter and possibly perform[n]an additional attack[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Disaster Shadows
entries.en: Disaster Shadows are tough. However, when defeated,[n][clr 2]they will drop an item[clr 27] and then explode, damaging[n]the surrounding Shadows.

entries.speaker: Disaster Shadows
entries.en: The more damage they take when defeated,[n][clr 2]the more damage they inflict to surrounding[n]Shadows[clr 27]. Time your attacks well!

entries.speaker: Disaster Shadows
entries.en: However, if a Disaster Shadow is defeated by a[n]reflected attack or by Despair, it will not explode[n]and it will not drop any items.
